in_marathi.name: Chakradhar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Holder of the wheel
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chakradhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chakradhar is derived from Sanskrit words 'Chakra' meaning wheel and 'Dhar' meaning holder. This name is bestowed upon individuals believed to hold the wheel of life or power in their hands.

in_bengali.name: Chakradhar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Holder of the wheel

This name is bestowed upon individuals believed to hold the wheel of life or power in their hands.
